_comment: Scoring rules shared by the workout matcher's two implementations: src/workout_matcher.py (server, used by webhook and iOS imports) and frontend/src/lib/workoutMatcher.ts (browser). Both read this file so the thresholds cannot drift apart. Parity is asserted by test_workout_matcher.py and frontend/src/lib/workoutMatcher.test.ts against data/matcher_fixtures.json.
_activityGates: A workout whose activity type contains one of a gate's keywords (case-insensitive) cannot auto-match a session unless one of the session's exercises needs that gate's equipment; its score is capped one below autoThreshold, so it can still be suggested. Modality alone is not enough: a Wildman anti-glycolytic swing session is aerobic_base, and so is a bike ride.
